record.question: Which of the following statements is not correct according the ML(PC) Act, 2014?
options: The ML(PC) Act permitted the establishment of wineries, bottling plants, and bonded warehouses under specific licenses
The ML(PC) Act allowed the sale and consumption of liquor across all districts of Mizoram, including the three autonomous districts
Under the ML(PC)Act, individuals were required to obtain permits to purchase and consume liquor
The ML(PC) Act was enacted to replace the Mizoram Liquor Total Prohibition Act, 1995
record.explanation: A departmental officer may be appointed as expert under Section 42.
